# Carcavelos Daily Brief – August 4th

**Glassy morning waves before the afternoon sea breeze kicks in.**

**MORNING (Best window: 05:00–10:00)**
Nearly perfect conditions to start. Light winds under 3km/h until 09:00, then gradually building. Waves holding steady at 0.76m with consistent 5.4–5.5s period—small but clean. Water temp 20°C, so a spring suit works. This is your window; catch it early before the sea breeze ramps up.

**AFTERNOON SHIFT**
Wind picks up from 10:00 onwards, reaching 16km/h by 17:00. Waves fade slightly to 0.72m as conditions lose shape around 12:00–15:00. Still rideable, just less refined.

**TIPS**
1. Set your alarm—05:00–07:00 is premium glassy time
2. Short board or fish; small swell rewards snappy equipment
3. Beat the afternoon crowds; most locals won't show until 16:00+ when wind direction steadies
